library_name: Destiny Core Noble and Scoundrel Talents
notes: Detailed, paraphrased Core Rulebook talent reference.

rules.name: Demand Surrender
rules.description: Compel a badly wounded opponent to surrender.

mechanics.use: Standard action, once per encounter and once per target each encounter.
mechanics.target: One opponent at half hit points or fewer.
mechanics.check: Persuasion vs. Will; target gains +5 Will if higher level than you.
mechanics.effect: Target surrenders, drops held weapons, and takes no hostile actions.
mechanics.duration: Until you or an ally attacks it.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting. A hailed vehicle at half HP may surrender through its commander; it cannot be more than one size larger, and higher-CL vehicles gain +5 Will.

rules.name: Improved Weaken Resolve
rules.description: Your Weaken Resolve victim continues fleeing even after being wounded.

mechanics.effect: Weaken Resolve no longer ends when the fleeing target is wounded.
mechanics.special: All other Weaken Resolve limits, saves, and vehicle rules remain unchanged.

rules.name: Presence
rules.description: Intimidate far more quickly.

mechanics.effect: Make the Persuasion check to intimidate a creature; it normally requires a full-round action.

rules.name: Weaken Resolve
rules.description: A threshold-breaking attack can terrify a weaker enemy into fleeing.

mechanics.trigger: You deal damage equal to or greater than the target's Damage Threshold.
mechanics.effect: A lower-level target flees from you at top speed and cannot take standard, swift, or full-round actions.
mechanics.duration: 1 minute, ending early if the target is wounded.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting. Equal- or higher-level targets are immune. Target may spend a Force Point as a free action or reaction to negate it. Can affect a hailed vehicle through its commander after threshold damage; higher-CL vehicles are immune.

rules.name: Bolster Ally
rules.description: Help a wounded ally recover condition and gain temporary resilience.

mechanics.use: Standard action, once per ally each encounter.
mechanics.target: One ally in line of sight at half maximum hit points or fewer.
mechanics.effect: Move the ally +1 step toward normal on the condition track and grant bonus hit points equal to its character level.
mechanics.duration: Unused bonus hit points disappear at encounter end.
mechanics.special: Damage removes bonus HP first. Mind-affecting; cannot target yourself.

rules.name: Ignite Fervor
rules.description: A successful attack inspires an ally's next damaging blow.

mechanics.use: Free action after you hit with a melee or ranged attack.
mechanics.target: One ally in your line of sight.
mechanics.effect: The ally gains bonus damage equal to its character level on its next attack.
mechanics.duration: Consumed by the next attack; lost if that attack misses.
mechanics.special: The ally need not remain in sight after selection. Mind-affecting; cannot target yourself.

rules.name: Inspire Confidence
rules.description: Grant allies lasting morale bonuses to attacks and skills.

mechanics.target: All allies in your line of sight.
mechanics.effect: All affected allies gain +1 morale on attack rolls and skill checks.
mechanics.duration: Rest of encounter, or until you are unconscious or dead; allies need not remain in sight.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; does not affect you.

rules.name: Inspire Haste
rules.description: Enable an ally to perform a standard-action skill task as a move action.

mechanics.target: One ally in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: On the ally's next turn, one skill check that normally costs a standard action costs a move action.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; cannot target yourself.

rules.name: Inspire Zeal
rules.description: Allies push enemies an additional step down the condition track.

mechanics.trigger: An ally in your line of sight attacks and moves an opponent down the condition track.
mechanics.effect: The attack moves the opponent one additional step down the condition track.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting benefit; cannot benefit yourself.

rules.name: Born Leader
rules.description: Give visible allies an encounter-long attack bonus while they follow your lead.

mechanics.target: All allies in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Grant +1 insight on attack rolls.
mechanics.duration: While each ally retains line of sight to you and you remain conscious and alive.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; cannot benefit yourself.

rules.name: Coordinate
rules.description: Make every visible ally's aid another attempt more effective.

mechanics.target: All allies in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Their aid another actions grant an additional +1 bonus.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; each selection adds another +1, to a maximum additional +5. Mind-affecting; cannot benefit yourself.

rules.name: Distant Command
rules.description: Born Leader continues to help allies after line of sight is broken.

mechanics.effect: Allies benefiting from Born Leader no longer lose its bonus merely because line of sight to you is broken.
mechanics.special: The bonus still ends if another Born Leader termination condition applies.

rules.name: Fearless Leader
rules.description: Give visible allies strong protection against fear.

mechanics.effect: Grant +5 morale to Will Defense against fear effects.
mechanics.duration: Remainder of encounter while the ally retains line of sight and you remain conscious and alive.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; cannot benefit yourself.

rules.name: Rally
rules.description: Rally badly wounded allies with defensive and damage bonuses.

mechanics.target: Visible allies below half maximum hit points.
mechanics.effect: Grant +2 morale to Reflex and Will Defenses and +2 on damage rolls.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; cannot benefit yourself. Can affect allied vehicles below half HP: +2 vehicle Reflex, +2 crew Will aboard it, and +2 vehicle-weapon damage before multiplier.

rules.name: Trust
rules.description: Give up your standard action so an ally gains another major action next turn.

mechanics.target: One ally in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: On its next turn, the ally gains one extra standard action or move action of its choice.
mechanics.special: The granted action remains even if line of sight is later broken. Mind-affecting; cannot target yourself.

rules.name: Connections
rules.description: Use personal connections to acquire controlled equipment more easily and cheaply.

mechanics.effect: Obtain licensed, restricted, military, or illegal equipment without licensing fees or background checks when its total cost is at most character level × 1,000 credits; reduce black-market cost multiplier by 1.
mechanics.special: Availability and actual purchase cost still apply.

rules.name: Educated
rules.description: Attempt every Knowledge specialty even without training.

mechanics.effect: You may make any Knowledge check untrained.

rules.name: Spontaneous Skill
rules.description: Temporarily treat one untrained skill check as trained.

mechanics.trigger: You make a check with a skill in which you are not trained.
mechanics.effect: Resolve that check as though trained, allowing trained-only uses.
mechanics.special: Use the Force requires Force Sensitivity. Repeatable; each selection adds one daily use.

rules.name: Wealth
rules.description: Receive a substantial recurring income based on Noble class levels.

mechanics.trigger: Each time you gain a character level, including the level at which this talent is selected.
mechanics.effect: Receive credits equal to 5,000 × your current Noble class level.
mechanics.special: Funds appear in an accessible civilized location or bank account of your choice.

rules.name: Fool's Luck
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to gain one strong encounter-long competence bonus.

mechanics.effect: Choose +1 competence on attack rolls, +5 competence on skill checks, or +1 competence to all Defenses.
mechanics.special: The Defense option also increases the Defenses of a vehicle you occupy.

rules.name: Fortune's Favor
rules.description: A critical hit grants an extra standard action.

mechanics.trigger: You score a critical hit with a melee or ranged attack.
mechanics.effect: Gain one free standard action.
mechanics.duration: Must be used before the end of the current turn or it is lost.

rules.name: Gambler
rules.description: Improve Wisdom checks made when gambling.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 competence on Wisdom checks to gamble.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; each selection adds another +2.

rules.name: Lucky Shot
rules.description: Reroll an attack and keep the better result.

mechanics.effect: Reroll and keep the better result.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; each selection adds one daily use.

rules.name: Dastardly Strike
rules.description: Successful attacks against defensively compromised enemies worsen their condition.

mechanics.trigger: You hit an opponent denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.effect: Move that target -1 step down the condition track in addition to normal attack effects.
mechanics.special: Cannot affect objects or vehicles.

rules.name: Disruptive
rules.description: Suppress morale and insight bonuses affecting visible enemies.

mechanics.target: Every enemy in your line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Suppress all morale and insight bonuses currently applied to those enemies.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.

rules.name: Skirmisher
rules.description: Moving before attacking improves accuracy.

mechanics.trigger: Before attacking, move at least 2 squares and finish in a different square from where you started.
mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on attack rolls.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: With vehicle weapons, only the pilot can gain this benefit.

rules.name: Sneak Attack
rules.description: Deal extra damage to a flat-footed enemy or one denied Dexterity to Reflex.

mechanics.trigger: A melee or ranged attack hits an opponent that is flat-footed or denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex.
mechanics.effect: Deal +1d6 damage per selection.
mechanics.special: Ranged Sneak Attack requires the target within 6 squares. Repeatable to a maximum +10d6.

rules.name: Walk the Line
rules.description: Momentarily reduce the Defenses of nearby visible opponents.

mechanics.target: Every opponent within 6 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Targets take -2 to all Defenses.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn; ends for a target if line of sight is broken.
mechanics.special: Range is 6 squares at starship scale when applicable.

rules.name: Gimmick
rules.description: Issue routine computer commands almost instantly.

mechanics.effect: Issue a routine command to a computer; this normally requires a standard action.

rules.name: Master Slicer
rules.description: Reroll attempts to improve computer access.

mechanics.trigger: Make a Use Computer check to improve access.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the check and keep the better result.

rules.name: Trace
rules.description: Use network searches in place of conventional information gathering.

mechanics.trigger: You have access to a computer network and would make a Gather Information check.
mechanics.effect: Use your Use Computer modifier and make a Use Computer check instead.

rules.name: Hyperdriven
rules.description: Once daily aboard a starship, add your Scoundrel level after seeing a roll.

mechanics.use: Once per day while aboard a starship.
mechanics.trigger: After seeing the result of one attack roll, skill check, or ability check.
mechanics.effect: Add your Scoundrel class level as a bonus to that roll or check.

rules.name: Spacehound
rules.description: Operate naturally in low gravity, ignore space sickness, and use starship weapons proficiently.

mechanics.effect: Take no low- or zero-gravity attack penalty, ignore space sickness, and count as proficient with every starship weapon.

rules.name: Starship Raider
rules.description: Attack more accurately while aboard a starship.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on attack rolls while aboard a starship, with both personal and starship weapons.

rules.name: Stellar Warrior
rules.description: A natural 20 aboard a starship grants a temporary Force Point.

mechanics.trigger: Roll a natural 20 on an attack made aboard a starship.
mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point.
mechanics.duration: Unused point disappears at encounter end.
mechanics.special: Works with personal and vehicle weapons aboard a starship.
